# Helix endpoints for Extensions (generated)

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-extension-endpoints.ts from source: https://dev.twitch.tv/docs/api/reference/ — do not edit by hand -->

Base URL `https://api.twitch.tv/helix`. Every request also needs `Client-Id: <extension client id>`.
EBS-JWT endpoints: `Authorization: Bearer <JWT you signed with the extension secret>` (see jwt-and-ebs.md).
Token endpoints: `Authorization: Bearer <OAuth token>`; for Bits products and Extension Transactions the
token must be an APP token of the EXTENSION's own client ID (client credentials; see the twitch-dev skill). Full details:
`grep -n "^## <Name>" <twitch-api skill>/references/official/api_reference.md`.

## Hand-checked caveats (static text in the generator — re-verify after a docs refresh)

- Send Extension Chat Message: the Authorization text lists only `role`/`user_id`, but its 401 list says the
  `broadcaster_id` query parameter must match the JWT `channel_id` claim — always sign with `channel_id`.
- Send Extension PubSub Message: `channel_id` = broadcaster ID + `pubsub_perms.send: ["broadcast"]` (or the
  whisper targets) for one channel; `channel_id: "all"` + `send: ["global"]` + `is_global_broadcast: true` for all.
  The Building guide additionally says "1 message per second per channel" and 5 KB per message.
- Get Extension Live Channels returns `pagination` as a STRING cursor, not the usual object.
- The scopes page lists `channel:manage:extensions` for Get User Active Extensions / Update User Extensions,
  while the endpoint pages say `user:read:broadcast` / `user:edit:broadcast`. Request what the endpoint page says.
- extension.bits_transaction.create (EventSub, webhook/conduit only — not WebSocket) is the push alternative to
  polling Get Extension Transactions; see the twitch-eventsub skill.

## Authorization text per endpoint (verbatim first paragraph)

- **Get Extension Analytics** — Requires a user access token that includes the analytics:read:extensions scope.
- **Get Extension Transactions** — Requires an app access token.
- **Get Extension Configuration Segment** — Requires a signed JSON Web Token (JWT) created by an Extension Backend Service (EBS). For signing requirements, see Signing the JWT. The signed JWT must include the `role`, `user_id`, and `exp` fields (see JWT Schema). The `role` field must be set to external.
- **Set Extension Configuration Segment** — Requires a signed JSON Web Token (JWT) created by an Extension Backend Service (EBS). For signing requirements, see Signing the JWT. The signed JWT must include the `role`, `user_id`, and `exp` fields (see JWT Schema). The `role` field must be set to external.
- **Set Extension Required Configuration** — Requires a signed JSON Web Token (JWT) created by an EBS. For signing requirements, see Signing the JWT. The signed JWT must include the `role`, `user_id`, and `exp` fields (see JWT Schema). Set the `role` field to external and the `user_id` field to the ID of the user that owns the extension.
- **Send Extension PubSub Message** — Requires a signed JSON Web Token (JWT) created by an Extension Backend Service (EBS). For signing requirements, see Signing the JWT. The signed JWT must include the `role`, `user_id`, and `exp` fields (see JWT Schema) along with the `channel_id` and `pubsub_perms` fields. The `role` field must be set to external.
- **Get Extension Live Channels** — Requires an app access token or user access token.
- **Get Extension Secrets** — Requires a signed JSON Web Token (JWT) created by an Extension Backend Service (EBS). For signing requirements, see Signing the JWT. The signed JWT must include the `role`, `user_id`, and `exp` fields (see JWT Schema). The `role` field must be set to external.
- **Create Extension Secret** — Requires a signed JSON Web Token (JWT) created by an Extension Backend Service (EBS). For signing requirements, see Signing the JWT. The signed JWT must include the `role`, `user_id`, and `exp` fields (see JWT Schema). The `role` field must be set to external.
- **Send Extension Chat Message** — Requires a signed JSON Web Token (JWT) created by an Extension Backend Service (EBS). For signing requirements, see Signing the JWT. The signed JWT must include the `role` and `user_id` fields (see JWT Schema). The `role` field must be set to external.
- **Get Extensions** — Requires a signed JSON Web Token (JWT) created by an Extension Backend Service (EBS). For signing requirements, see Signing the JWT. The signed JWT must include the `role` field (see JWT Schema), and the `role` field must be set to external.
- **Get Released Extensions** — Requires an app access token or user access token.
- **Get Extension Bits Products** — Requires an app access token. The client ID in the app access token must be the extension’s client ID.
- **Update Extension Bits Product** — Requires an app access token. The client ID in the app access token must match the extension’s client ID.
- **Get User Extensions** — Requires a user access token that includes the user:read:broadcast or user:edit:broadcast scope. To include inactive extensions, you must include the user:edit:broadcast scope.
- **Get User Active Extensions** — Requires an app access token or user access token.
- **Update User Extensions** — Requires a user access token that includes the user:edit:broadcast scope.

17 endpoints.
